text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. White-black polka-dot nipped-waist double-breasted jacket with black collar, black mini skirt and sheer black tights, no unshown shoes.
original_prompt: Precise product image edit. Remove all body, legs, feet and skin. Flat lay the same polka dot jacket and black mini skirt, with EMPTY collapsed sheer tights beside them. No anatomical volume, no shoes or accessories. Preserve all unmentioned details. Pure white background, soft studio light, fully uncropped portrait 2:3 1024x1536. No person, body, skin, mannequin, stand, reference inset, labels or watermark.
